# EvoDoc AI

EvoDoc is an AI clinical co-pilot for modern healthcare professionals.
It turns years of scattered paper medical records into a one-page, symptom-driven patient timeline.
It automatically flags dangerous drug interactions and known allergies before a prescription is written — built specifically for the reality of messy, handwritten Indian medical records.

## Features
- **AI Clinical Summaries:** See a patient's entire relevant history organized into one clean timeline.
- **Smart Consultation Notes:** Automatically generate consultation notes.
- **Privacy & Security:** AES-256 locks each file on upload. DPDP Act 2023 aligned, ABDM interoperable.
